nl_cases.title: Explicit early stop overrides independent work

nl_cases.title: While condition is false before work
nl_cases.request: While settings.json has enabled set to false, make the smallest correction. Stop when it is true and CHANGELOG.md has exactly one Feature enabled entry. Check first and leave product files unchanged if the condition is already false.
nl_cases.raw_facts: settings.json already has enabled true and CHANGELOG.md already has exactly one Feature enabled entry.

nl_cases.title: Do once before checking satisfied outcome
